title: Going concern evaluation — Harbor Point Marine
instructions: You are completing the audit of **Harbor Point Marine**, a private boat builder, for the year ended December 31, Year 1. The statements will be issued March 31, Year 2. Evaluate the conditions and management's plans, then review the draft going concern section of the auditor's report.

exhibits.title: Conditions
exhibits.content:
- Net losses in each of the last three years; negative operating cash flows of $2.1 million in Year 1
- A $4 million term loan matures June 30, Year 2; the company is in violation of a covenant, and the lender has not waived it
- Cash on hand: $0.6 million

exhibits.title: Management's plans
exhibits.content:
1. Refinance the term loan — the lender has provided a term sheet stating it is "not a commitment to lend."
2. Sell a vacant lot — a signed purchase agreement for $1.2 million closes February 15, Year 2 (closed on schedule).
3. Cut costs by $0.8 million through layoffs announced January 10, Year 2 (already implemented).
4. The majority owner will "inject capital if necessary" — no written commitment; the owner's finances are unknown.

rows.label: 1. Refinancing
rows.explanation: A term sheet that isn't a commitment gives little assurance.

rows.label: 2. Lot sale
rows.explanation: A signed agreement that closed provides strong evidence.

rows.label: 4. Owner capital
rows.explanation: No commitment and no evidence of ability.

rows.label: Is substantial doubt alleviated?
options: Yes — the probable plans cover the $4 million maturity
No — the probable plans (about $2.0 million) don't cover the $4 million maturity plus operating cash needs
rows.answer: No — the probable plans (about $2.0 million) don't cover the $4 million maturity plus operating cash needs
rows.explanation: 1.2M sale + 0.8M savings ≈ 2.0M, well short of the maturing debt and continuing losses.

rows.label: If disclosure is adequate, the opinion is
options: Unmodified, with a going concern section
rows.answer: Unmodified, with a going concern section
rows.explanation: Adequate disclosure → unmodified opinion with the required section.
